title: Build and evaluate a two-stage ranking pipeline

blocks.text: A reranker can reorder retrieved candidates, but it cannot recover a relevant item that retrieval omitted. The task is: Run a small two-stage evaluation with supplied retrieve(query,N)->IDs and rerank(query,IDs)->scores callbacks. Deduplicate candidates, validate score alignment/finite values, stable-sort by reranker score, and return query results plus mean actual NDCG. No fitting is performed; callbacks must already be trained without test-label access.

The inputs are `queries`, `retrieve`, `rerank`, `relevance`, `candidate_count`, `k`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
A reranker can reorder retrieved candidates, but it cannot recover a relevant item that retrieval omitted.
blocks.title: Core idea: Retrieval ceiling

blocks.latex: NDCG\le f(\text{relevant documents present in candidates})

blocks.text: Read each symbol as a value with a specific axis, time, rank, token, or state role. The code must preserve those roles. A compact formula does not remove the validation, masking, boundary, or state rules in the prompt.

Before following the implementation, identify the output's shape and meaning. Then identify which input values can affect one selected output. This gives you a testable mental model before the code adds implementation detail.
What changes in the boundary case

No fitting is performed; callbacks must already be trained without test-label access. Use the Trace control to switch between the normal path and this boundary focus. The algorithm does not get permission to invent an unstated fallback.

A useful test changes one condition while holding the remaining inputs fixed. Compare the output shape, state transition, valid edges, selected tokens, or returned status. This isolates the reason for the change.
A diagram can show data moving and still hide a wrong contract. Check the mask direction, reduction axis, update order, and ownership of persistent state against the prompt.
